policy: One combined TASM1/2 Red kit; Overclock, Dragnet and Vortex are its final added skills. The requested cape-free Across the Spider-Verse 2099 Black appearance is published; the Hunter combat design (revision 2, 2026-10-23) keeps the seven native Black rows and adds eight Black rows on free saved bits, all unimplemented. Preserve native controls, ownership/dependencies, Both Suits traversal and rewards. Prices, third suit, save expansion and branches remain deferred.

implemented: Combined TASM1/2 identity and existing suit appearance
Seven rewritten native Red purchase slots
Web Rush, Ricochet, Momentum, Overclock, Dragnet and Vortex Red rows
Both Suits Vitality I-III, existing ownership/refund rules and native traversal
suits.kit: Strike, cancel with R, reposition and resume through the existing thirteen Red purchases. Fast authored acrobatics and crowd control; native A/B/base strings and unowned evade stay intact.

suits.validation_limit: Early kit praise, Snap Sweep and original Web Vault are player evidence. v0.29 native-velocity Skyjack, wall/R and 68 kit checks pass; later feel/full-route acceptance remains a player gate.

combat_design.request: Make Black play and fight as close as possible to Miguel O'Hara in Across the Spider-Verse; make it fun to play. Revision 1 review: avoid one-trick pinning, give bosses a real answer, add webbing and air combos, add as many rows as a coherent kit needs within the 2D mob/boss brawler.
combat_design.supersedes: Hunter revision 1 (pin-centred, 2026-10-23) and the 2026-10-22 catch/carry/crash/chase proposal

suits.implementation_order: Appearance shipped (v0.30.2/v0.30.3). Combat awaits the player's go-ahead: clear the space, shop, input, Black-only animation, body/web and boss-adapter gates; prove Web Yank alone, then the Sky slice (Talon Lift, Sky Rake, Reel In, Meteor Catch), the boss slice (Boarding, Freefall, Pounce + Relentless) and the crowd slice, one player verdict at a time.
implemented: Guarded per-form selection in shared player model; exact Red list/texture retained
Broader chest/lats/traps/deltoids, athletic thighs and narrower jaw on unchanged native rig/animations
Six swept surface-mounted forearm blades and small talon tips
Red web cape and all cape geometry/atlas region removed
Opaque 128x128 I8 atlas: navy/cobalt, angular mask/chest spider, red shoulder panels and knee chevrons; same 16 KiB pixel pool
suits.kit: Hunter design revision 2 (2026-10-23, unimplemented): talon, web, air and boss pillars on the exact native Power Dash/Hammer Spike/Hammer Slam foundation; webs on X when no native X prompt is in reach; Vulture-style Boarding against bosses; pinning is one finisher. Ordinary B/base strings/R, ownership, dependencies and progression are unchanged.
